description: All-GPT codex line — flash uses gpt-5.6-luna for near-zero-cost exploration with 1M context (replaced two-generations-old gpt-5.1-codex-mini), standard runs gpt-5.6-terra for everyday orchestration (replaced gpt-5.1), pro steps up to gpt-5.6-sol for coding-heavy work at $2/$10 (replaced deprecated gpt-5.3-codex), max stays on sol since it is the strongest in-family survivor of the $3/$15 red line, and vision reuses luna (5.6 line supports image inputs). Requires OPENCODE_API_KEY environment variable (OpenCode Zen).
